تستعبدن (form X)
# تَسْتَعْبِدْنَ (tastaʕbidna) /tas.taʕ.bid.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
# تُسْتَعْبَدْنَ (tustaʕbadna) /tus.taʕ.bad.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعْبَدَ (istaʕbada)
